My TIC-X

My TIC-X

My TIC-X is a movie ticket resale platform that helps people recover money from unused movie tickets by connecting them with buyers looking for discounted tickets.

Sellers list eligible tickets at lower prices and minimise their losses. Buyers get a more affordable movie experience. My TIC-X aims to make resale convenient, transparent and secure through ticket verification and reliable transfer processes.
